preconditions.description: The length of the input string s must be between 1 and 100,000 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s must consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly |s| lines, one for each suffix of the string.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()[0]) == len(line.split()[1]) if len(line.split()[1]) <= 10 else len(line.split()[1]) == 7 for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line must contain the length of the answer and the answer itself, formatted correctly based on the length of the answer.

postconditions.expression: all(line.split()[1] == s[i:] for i, line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: The answers must correspond to the lexicographically smallest strings obtained from the suffixes of the input string.
